commits.subject: Improve google-cloud-storage-basics skill triggering for Storage MCP server setup
commits.summary: Expanded the skill description and Quick Start with remote/local Storage MCP setup, revised routing and installation guidance, and changed gcloud attribution examples to append the skill tag while preserving existing metrics attribution.

commits.subject: Enforce semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) for skills.
commits.summary: Changed the skill metadata version from v1 to 1.0.0.

commits.subject: Clarify in the google-cloud-developer routing rule that catalog skills are fetched and followed in-session rather than installed, and stop the Cloud Storage skill from promising that a newly installed skill is immediately usable.
commits.summary: Revised installation guidance to note that availability varies by agent, recommending confirmation that the skill loaded and noting that a restart may be required.

commits.subject: Fix metadata tags format for GCS skills and re-enable in Cloud Skill Registry
commits.summary: Reformatted the skill metadata, changing tags from a YAML list to a comma-separated string and removing the support_tier field.

commits.subject: Route agents from google-cloud-storage-basics to specialized GCS skills
commits.summary: Added routing to specialized skills for production bucket design, advanced GCSFuse, 403/IAM troubleshooting, and security assessments, with corresponding updates to Quick Start and reference guidance.

commits.subject: Use block-style YAML for skill metadata tags
commits.summary: Changed metadata tags from an inline YAML list to a block-style YAML list.

commits.subject: Update google-cloud-storage-basics metadata
commits.summary: Added Apache-2.0 licensing and reorganized metadata to include version, publisher, tags, and support tier, keeping Storage as the category.

commits.subject: Add User-Agent header attribution for GCS MCP server usage.
commits.summary: Extended HTTP User-Agent attribution guidance to cover requests to the Cloud Storage MCP server as well as direct API calls.

commits.subject: remove dev knowledge mcp server instruction
commits.summary: Removed the instruction to use the Developer Knowledge MCP server's search_documents tool for missing product information.
